notes.title: Devlog 3: changing amira's dress changes her herself from peace to confidence
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=5V8oHJ_93UQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello it is me Motasem the sole developer behind amira, in this devlog, i present to you, a really difficult and hard topic, and it is clothing in our culture, and how i connected the gameplay with the most prevalent emotions one would feel upon choosing different dresses, in a culture where what you wear is very focused and a big decision.

Exploring this issue, i decided to merge it with the gameplay, for a start it was the stats system, and more is coming.
